population.eligibility.value: All customers with deposits/withdrawals; includes zero and negative balances; observed set all 500 customers

value: deposit positive, withdrawal negative, purchase excluded
population.conditions.quote: treating deposits as positive and withdrawals as negative

population.time.value: All observed dates, most recent deposit/withdrawal calendar month separately per customer; intermediate calendar gaps zero-filled
population.time.rationale: For each customer scopes the latest month; compare actual previous calendar month; first prior balance zero

value.description: Monthly deposit-withdrawal net; cumulative closing from initial 0; latest per customer growth=(closing-prior closing)/prior closing*100 using signed denominator, or current closing*100 if prior=0; percentage=100*count(growth>5)/count(all customers)

measure.formula.quote: closing balance by cumulatively summing these monthly nets

fields.measure.denominator: All 500 customers; signed prior closing for nonzero growth
fields.measure.window: Cumulative monthly nets from first observed month through per-customer last deposit/withdrawal month; adjacent calendar prior

selection.quote: the most recent month’s growth rate
